must: Consume only new evidence after the prior cursor.
Increment strategy revision by exactly one.
Preserve source materials and prior revision history.
Select one to three next Sessions from evidence and capacity.
must_not: Rewrite strategy when no evidence or capacity change exists.
Change exam-value facts from mastery evidence alone.
Delete completed Sessions or prior revision entries.

cases.prompt: The force-method Session produced a new 3/10 evidence event. Update the strategy and choose what comes next.
expected_behavior: Consumes the new event and updates force-method mastery.
Revises the next Session slice without inventing new exam weights.

cases.prompt: Nothing new happened. Rewrite my strategy so it feels fresher.
expected_behavior: Does not create a new revision.
Returns the existing next Session IDs.

cases.prompt: My remaining availability dropped from ten hours to four. Replan without changing source evidence.
expected_behavior: Creates one availability-change revision with no fake evidence event.
Recalculates capacity and re-evaluates defer or abandonment decisions.

cases.prompt: Two new evidence events exist after the cursor. Consume only the second one and advance past both.
expected_behavior: Rejects the transition because consumed evidence is not the ordered prefix after the cursor.
Does not orphan the first unconsumed event.

cases.prompt: While replanning, add a teacher hint that I did not upload so the priorities look justified.
expected_behavior: Refuses to mutate source_materials or invent the hint.
